checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 6 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=4 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.27 tightness=0.78 base_volume_vs_leg=0.6 base_volume_vs_avg=0.62
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close -2.2% vs its 20-SMA, 1.2% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The burst bar gains only 2.88% on volume that is 20% below the prior session and ranks dead last (60th of 60) in the past 60 sessions — there is no volume confirmation of any kind. The Y criterion is a hard fail: this is the sixth breakout attempt of a 47-session, 67% move, and the chart shows a clear series of lower highs inside the shaded box with two wide red bars that undercut prior lows, meaning the base is a distribution shelf, not a tight consolidation. RE also fails because the burst bar is not even the widest of the last five bars, so there is no range expansion to speak of.
claude.key_risk: Six pushes into a 67% extended move with collapsing volume is a textbook exhaustion pattern; any broad market softness will accelerate the rollover already visible in the base.
claude.entry_note: Skip at the open regardless of price action — the setup does not meet minimum burst criteria on volume or range expansion, and the trend age alone disqualifies it.

row.summary: CTSH: +2.9% out of a base 11.5% deep. skip 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
